title: Release Conductor Runbook: SDK & API Surface Orchestration for Streaming, Structured Schemas, and Function Calls
creator: Maya Patel
description: Coordinated launch plan to ship the combined SDK + API surface for streaming responses, structured output (JSON-schema driven), and first-class function calling. Deliverables: SDK releases (Python/JS/Go), canonical samples repo with 3 end-to-end examples, API docs, migration guide, and release notes. This ticket is the runbook to manage timelines, cross-team handoffs, and gating criteria for staged rollout.
acceptance_criteria: Published API spec updates for structured output and function calling on docs.redwood.ai with example payloads
Tagged SDK releases in Python/JS/Go with release notes and semantic version bump
Canonical samples repo contains: streaming chat example, structured-output validation example, function-calling orchestration example
Automated compatibility tests run in CI across latest model variants and pass (>= 95% for core flows)
Telemetry dashboards validate latency, error-rate, and parsing success for new patterns during internal dogfood
Security review checklist completed and sign-off from Security and Compliance teams
Migration guide published for customers with breaking changes flagged and recommended migration steps

risk_and_mitigation: Risk: Structured output parsing failures under partial streaming chunks — Mitigation: QE harness to test chunked schema reassembly and add client-side backpressure examples
Risk: Backwards-incompatible SDK surface changes break customers — Mitigation: provide migration shims in SDKs, clear migration guide, and feature flag for gradual enablement
Risk: Higher-than-expected latency for streaming with schema validation — Mitigation: recommend server-side optional validation and client-side light-checks; measure cost impact in preflight tests
Risk: Security sign-off delays due to KMS integration — Mitigation: early engagement with Security, create a minimal compliance checklist, and schedule a gated sync
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (Internal): Ship SDK RCs to internal devs and platform teams; 48h validation window — target 2026-03-25
Phase 1 (Dogfood + Beta): Enable feature flag for 5 beta customers and monitor telemetry for 7 days — target 2026-03-30
Phase 2 (Wider Beta): Relax limits and expose to broader customer cohort (20 customers) while keeping opt-in — target 2026-04-05
Phase 3 (GA): Remove opt-in flag and publish GA docs, blog, and SDK stable releases — target 2026-04-12
Rollback policy: revert SDK package versions and flip feature flag to previous behavior; run postmortem if metrics exceed thresholds
release_notes_outline: Short summary, highlights (streaming API improvements, structured output schemas, function-calling orchestration), breaking changes and migration steps, sample snippets, supported SDK versions, telemetry keys and how to interpret, known issues and troubleshooting tips.
samples_matrix: Three canonical samples: 1) Streaming assistant with incremental UI updates (Python + JS frontend), 2) Structured invoice extraction with JSON Schema validation and retry logic (Go server), 3) Multi-step function-calling orchestration (JS) integrating external API and fallback model fallback. Each sample includes: README, minimal infra (Dockerfile), CI check, and expected telemetry events.

Run chaos test for partial network disconnects during streaming and observe reconnection behavior
